taxonomy_definition: The error taxonomy is multi-label: an individual test case execution may exhibit multiple failure modes simultaneously (e.g. omitting an expected numerical value while also asserting an unsupported claim). Total error occurrence sums exceed the total number of test cases because individual cases frequently exhibit multiple distinct errors.
